g.title: Long shot. Alice, left, pointing, looking at Bob; Bob, centre, arms crossed. Sound effect: HONK. Alice: Is that the press?
Medium close-up. A street at dusk. Bob, centre, happy. Editor's note: Printed in black, every word. Bob: The last one tonight.
Full shot. An alley at night. Alice, centre; Bob, centre, arms crossed. Sound effect: CLANG. Bob: Then it goes to the binders. Alice: And the plates?
